title: One-Pan Citrus Chicken and Potatoes
content:
This is a weeknight dinner that feels like more than the sum of its parts. Citrus brightens the pan, the potatoes soak up the juices, and the cleanup is easy.

Use a single sheet pan and let the oven do the work while you set the table or wash a few dishes.

Ingredients

  • 4 chicken thighs, bone-in or boneless
  • 1 pound small potatoes, halved
  • 1 orange, sliced thin
  • 1 lemon, sliced thin
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 2 cloves garlic, smashed
  • 1 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
  • 1 teaspoon dried oregano

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
  2. Toss potatoes with half of the olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread them on the pan.
  3. Rub chicken with the remaining oil, garlic, oregano, and a pinch of salt.
  4. Nestle the chicken among the potatoes and tuck citrus slices around everything.
  5. Roast for 30 to 40 minutes, until the chicken is browned and potatoes are tender.

Small variations

  • Add a handful of green beans for color.
  • Swap oregano for rosemary or thyme.
  • Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon for extra brightness.
One pan, one timer, and a table that smells like citrus.

Serve straight from the pan with a simple salad. The leftovers are excellent the next day.
